question.problem:
Consider two sets of $8$ paired observations ${x}_{1},{x}_{2},…,{x}_{8},$ and ${y}_{1},{y}_{2},…,{y}_{8}.$

You are given that

$$
\begin{aligned} & {\sum }_{i=1}^{8}({x}_{i}-\overset{―}{x})^{2}=1.6, \\  & {\sum }_{i=1}^{8}({y}_{i}-\overset{―}{y})^{2}=5.1, \\  & {\sum }_{i=1}^{8}({x}_{i}-\overset{―}{x})({y}_{i}-\overset{―}{y})=2.3.\end{aligned}
$$

Then, ${S}_{xy}=$
{{field-1}}.
question.worked_solution:
Given a set of $n$ paired observations ${x}_{1},{x}_{2},…,{x}_{n}$ and ${y}_{1},{y}_{2},…,{y}_{n},$ ${S}_{xy}$ is the sum of products of the deviations of ${x}_{i}$ and ${y}_{i}$ from their respective means, that is

$$
\begin{aligned}{S}_{xy} & ={\sum }_{i=1}^{n}({x}_{i}-\overset{―}{x})({y}_{i}-\overset{―}{y}).\end{aligned}
$$

From the given statistics, we have

$$
\begin{aligned}{S}_{xy} & ={\sum }_{i=1}^{n}({x}_{i}-\overset{―}{x})({y}_{i}-\overset{―}{y}) \\  & =2.3.\end{aligned}
$$
